probeEvidence.interpretation: Rows are experimental observations, including confirmed defects;47 retained rows do not mean47 acceptance predicates passed.

findings.title: Result validation can record success without terminal or containment evidence
findings.basis: reproduced through actual CLI, actual pinned Foreman launcher and AF_UNIX handshake
findings.observed: forged_exact_authenticated_empty_evidence completed the real handshake with exact current invocation identities, durably wrote a PROCESS_SUCCESS document with evidence=[] and invocationId=null, and sent contained. No service commands ran. CLI returned 0, finished the reservation, emitted loan_process_success and released wallet ownership.
findings.cause: The reader checks only references that happen to be listed; it does not require or interpret the terminal, startup, cleanup, stop or timer evidence. Disposition trusts top-level flags. Root's independently retained reader-level controls also accept string flags, boolean return codes and stopErrorClass=TimeoutError.
findings.required: Validate exact scalar types, closed status/raw-exit/failure-code combinations, nonzero invocation identity where required, mandatory evidence kinds and unique paths, and the contents/cross-digests of startup, terminal, explicit-stop, containment and timer evidence. Derive success from those facts. An authenticated channel is not evidence of process completion.
regressions: Exact handshake/identities with absent evidence stays unresolved and active.
Wrong evidence kind, unrelated valid digest, contradictory terminal fields, wrong invocation, string flags, boolean return codes and stop errors cannot produce success.

findings.title: Early REFUSED exception closes unresolved ownership
findings.basis: reproduced through actual CLI without completing a handshake
findings.observed: forged_early_refused_uncontained supplied REFUSED/exit2 with all four invocation identities null, containmentComplete=false and an outstanding timer owner. CLI returned4 but closed the reservation failed, recorded refused_before_start and released ownership.
findings.cause: _disposition_for accepts any parsed REFUSED/2 after invocation append regardless of handshake, acknowledgment, identity nulls, containment or outstanding owners.
findings.required: Treat a no-handshake/null-identity report as untrusted diagnostic evidence. Close only on independently established no-resource-start or exact validated containment for the current invocation; otherwise retain active reservation and durable ownership. Do not infer no start from the status label.
regressions: The reproduced null-identity/uncontained case stays runner_unresolved.
Valid refusal before start retains the consumed debit and closes only when the parent can establish the no-start predicate.
Refusal with a setup timer that cannot be canceled retains its outstanding owner.

findings.title: Ownership-release refusal does not affect CLI completion
findings.basis: reproduced after the actual executor completed against isolated service transports
findings.observed: ownership_release_refused_after_success changed the isolated ownership reservation before release. release_ownership returned Refusal and ownership stayed runtime-held, but CLI returned0, finished the reservation and recorded success.
findings.cause: Runner records ownershipReleased=false but leaves disposition success; cmd_run ignores ownershipReleased.
findings.required: A failed/unavailable release must prevent operational completion and preserve occupancy, while retaining any known main result. Commit the result/history/ownership completion relationship without a gap that admits another primary.
regressions: Wrong ownership reservation, release refusal and release write/fsync failure keep reservation active and CLI4.
Known main failure plus release failure retains both known failure and unresolved occupancy.

findings.title: Two required evidence writes are ignored
findings.basis: 24 actual syscall fault cases across six artifacts; eight reproduced this defect
findings.observed: runtime-plan-comparison.json and timer-armed.json each suffered actual os.write failure, file-fsync failure, directory-fsync failure and stalled directory fsync. Each fault hit exactly once, stalled workers were killed, and every case still returned PROCESS_SUCCESS/0. The failed artifact was omitted from evidence.
findings.cause: Both session.persist results are discarded, so successful later stages erase the operational effect of missing required evidence.
findings.required: Require both durable outcomes before advancing to dependent startup. A missing comparison or timer record must refuse before resource start or trigger the specified owned cleanup if startup has already occurred. Feed incomplete evidence into final validation.
regressions: Repeat actual syscall-level file and directory failure/stall controls for every artifact, asserting that the intended operation was reached.
Neither missing required evidence nor a partial file may yield process success.

findings.title: Accounting verifier accepts materially invalid current evidence
findings.basis: three whole-CLI negative controls plus source inspection of shared verifier
findings.observed: Actual CLI runs accepted zero quantity for an unrelated token with wrong units, an unrelated sourceSha256, and a failed-attempt receipt substituted for the expected pending-use disposition; all returned0 and started the isolated fake resources. The positive fixture has no observer parent-evidence file and placeholder observerExecution commitments; the verifier does not read that evidence. verify_history checks receipt hashes and event lineage columns but does not verify receipt contents/outcomes/resolutions. Current master checks recompute selected-envelope S/n but omit reserve-transfer, retained predecessor/master invariants and exact amendment G equality.
findings.cause: The source checks shape and selected equality predicates instead of the specified observer evidence, exact source/plan/funding identity, history semantics and current authority. verify_observation trusts true child booleans and accepts any listed history digest as pending-use evidence.
findings.required: Implement the consumer-side validators for the specified producer interface even while the producer remains a separate dependency. Validate retained parent evidence, exact observer/SDK/source context, expected pending-use disposition, selected asset/unit/required available amounts and final-plan identities, history receipt contents and applicable resolutions, and the authenticated current grant/reserve invariants. Missing required producer evidence must be unavailable, not silently trusted.
regressions: Retained wrong-token/units/source/pending-use cases deny before resource start.
Missing or contradictory parent evidence and child-supplied unchanged/contained flags deny.
Wrong history outcome/resolution/event payload, mismatched reserve transfer, duplicate allocation and wrong amendment grant deny; authentic complete fixtures still pass without spending live credit.

findings.title: Funding freshness is not rechecked at financial startup
findings.basis: reproduced with injected monotonic/wall clocks and real validators
findings.observed: observation_ages_past120_during_setup admitted observation age20s, advanced setup110s while staying before outer+120, then started prover and financial unit at observation age130s and returned PROCESS_SUCCESS/0.
findings.cause: validate_current runs once before runtime-plan/config/timer work. No subsequent freshness validation precedes resource/financial startup.
findings.required: Recheck both observedAt and syncTime against the same authenticated observation immediately before financial startup, using the recorded time basis and monotonic elapsed age. Refuse expired evidence without refresh, refund or shifted deadline.
regressions: An observation valid on entry but older than120s at startup denies.
Cover90/120 boundaries, future timestamps, setup delay and wall-clock changes; retain debit/claim and no implicit refresh.

findings.title: Cleanup does not preserve exact resource identity through destructive commands
findings.basis: reproduced against isolated cleanup service state machine
findings.observed: A unit replacement inserted after kill and before stop was stopped without a second identity query and cleanup declared complete. A prover receipt naming a different containerId and a unit receipt naming another unit were each accepted; the intended fake resources were killed and cleanup declared complete.
findings.cause: load_receipt validates schema/allocation/invocation digest but not receipt resource identities against intent; contain_owned uses only receipt InvocationID/StartedAt. One unit identity check precedes both kill and stop. Post-operation containment does not consistently bind the retained generation/control group.
findings.required: Validate exact receipt resource, claim/reservation and control-group identities. Requery immediately before each destructive command, including stop following kill; refuse replacement generations and retain unresolved ownership. Bind final containment observations to the owned resource generation.
regressions: Wrong containerId/unit/control group/claim in receipt never authorizes a kill.
Replacement between separate destructive steps must survive untouched by the old invocation.
Post-kill observation of a different generation cannot establish containment of the original.

findings.title: Actual timer and cumulative cleanup do not enforce the absolute schedule
findings.basis: reproduced timer/cumulative-clock controls; relative activation bound issue also follows from source
findings.observed: An active timer reporting unrelated Unit and NextElapseUSecMonotonic=9999999999999999999 was accepted and execution returned0. contain_owned with one second remaining gave all seven commands a fresh one-second allowance and declared complete after6.3 simulated seconds. The full late-clock control continued cleanup/result work to virtual+1746, returning PROCESS_UNKNOWN/3, not success.
findings.cause: Timer and RuntimeMaxSec values are relative to later manager activation; the actual timer deadline and target are not validated. Cleanup computes its bound once for several commands; persistence/result code converts exhausted time to a new one-second budget using 'or 1'. The timer helper also grants each command the full bound.
findings.required: Use and validate actual absolute monotonic cutoffs, including timer target/next elapse and delayed unit activation. Recompute remaining time before every command/write, reserve result/ack time, and never grant a fresh budget after the cutoff. Independently armed containment must remain when bounded foreground cleanup cannot finish.
regressions: Wrong/delayed timer target or next elapse denies startup.
Multiple near-bound commands/writes cannot exceed the shared phase deadline.
Startup delays do not shift +1606/+1620; +1740 result/ack and60s outer margin remain enforced.

findings.title: Result-path read can block the caller after child supervision ends
findings.basis: reproduced on an isolated actual CLI invocation before the automatic interruption
findings.observed: fifo_result_blocks_actual_cli left a nonregular result destination. After the child exited, CLI blocked in wait_for_partner and had to be stopped by the bounded scratch probe after6s. No live service was used.
findings.cause: _read_result_document opens the result with blocking O_RDONLY before checking its type; no fstat regular-file check or bounded read worker protects this post-child operation. The outer child loop no longer bounds it.
findings.required: Open no-follow and nonblocking, verify a regular contained file from the opened descriptor, then perform bounded size/read validation. Treat malformed/unavailable result files as unresolved without hanging; protect evidence reads similarly.
regressions: Nonregular, symlink, oversized, disappearing or unreadable result paths return bounded unresolved outcomes with active reservation.
Post-child result/evidence reading stays within the absolute completion budget.

findings.title: Container prevalidation does not pin the proof-server command
findings.basis: reproduced by actual executor with isolated Docker/config transports; C source inspected
findings.observed: arbitrary_prover_argv replaced the inspected post-wrapper command with /bin/sh and unreviewed operands. The executor accepted the config, started the fake container and returned PROCESS_SUCCESS/0.
findings.cause: Prevalidation compares only Args[:2] to control path and '--'. The existing C wrapper executes the subsequent supplied argv; it does not itself restrict it to the pinned proof-server executable/arguments.
findings.required: Bind and compare the full actual wrapper/proof-server argv and required container configuration against reviewed immutable source/instance authority before start. Preserve the existing static wrapper and independent absolute control; do not claim this finding means the wrapper is absent.
regressions: Changed proof-server path, extra/missing arguments, changed control mount mapping or inadmissible container config rejects before Docker start.
The correct pinned command still satisfies the existing wrapper deadline/parser/descendant tests.

findings.title: Loaded startup and running-observation predicates are weaker than the closed table
findings.observed: Missing ActiveEnterTimestampMonotonic at startup still yielded PROCESS_SUCCESS/0. Running observations with Type=oneshot, RemainAfterExit=no or Transient=no were classified PROCESS_UNKNOWN internally but collector returned NOT_TERMINAL with no terminal files. Running with terminal ExecMainCode=1 was also treated as pending.
findings.cause: Startup validation does not require the actual start timestamp. The collector's separate _same_invocation_running shortcut overrides the stricter classification; the classifier's running row does not reject terminal record combinations.
findings.required: Use one closed classification predicate for polling and terminal decisions; invalid identity/property/terminal combinations are terminal unknown, never pending. Validate and retain actual positive startup time/control-group identity before collection.
regressions: Each reproduced inconsistent running row returns terminal unknown once without retry or evidence-driven stop.
Missing/default/malformed startup time or identity prevents a success path.
Preserve all exit1..255 and signal1..64 failure rows and the strict exit0 predicate.

findings.title: Implemented runtime master transition ignores the budget lock and uses unsupervised writes
findings.basis: actual CLI lock control plus source inspection; write-stall test for this mutator not performed
findings.observed: master_lock_held_during_handover held the required predecessor-derived .lock in another process while actual CLI rewrote the master, completed the loan fixture and returned0. _replace_file directly loops on os.write and fsync in the parent; no bounded worker or shared cutoff supervises handover or release.
findings.cause: The runner acquires the wallet lock but not the deterministic budget lock around master/current correspondence validation and transition. This source slice already performs production master mutations, despite deferring the full producer.
findings.required: Serialize the implemented transition with the specified existing budget lock and preserve continuous wallet ownership. Supervise mutation/persistence under a bounded shared deadline; interrupted writes remain consumed/unavailable until reconciliation. Preserve the required order of reservation handover and one-shot claim.
regressions: A held budget lock denies or waits only within the admitted bound without modifying the master.
Actual write/file/directory fsync stalls in handover and release are bounded and retain uncertainty.
Concurrent contenders and interrupted generations cannot overwrite each other's master progress.

findings.title: SP01 verify fixture bypasses the intended live admission branch
findings.basis: actual live-label validator control plus caller/source inspection
findings.observed: The complete CLI fixture uses sp01-loan-verify and historical design binding/acceptance. Changing to the required binding status admitted-i2-source-only is rejected by _verify_binding as binding-status-unsupported. _evidence_applicable also excludes finalized-financial-settlement for admitted statuses. No successful required live-profile cmd_run fixture exists.
findings.cause: Existing records validators were extended only with generic helpers, not the required exact live-label/current-review/acceptance/prerequisite bridge consumers. The historical verify action therefore exercises different source/resource/history/primary predicates. A future registration alone cannot repair these source denials.
findings.required: Complete or explicitly stage the specified item1.2 source interfaces and demonstrate the actual SP05.3/i2/MC02/finalized-financial-settlement branch on isolated complete authority. Preserve historical design behavior and exact fresh current routing. The producer/new real instance may remain separately pending, but generic verify success cannot be the required live consumer acceptance.
regressions: Real cmd_run succeeds on an isolated authentic exact live-source/profile fixture and individually rejects near-miss labels/currentness/anchor/history defects.
Historical design verification remains unchanged; stale SP01 actions remain stale.
All-kind primary/claim/retry limits apply to the live branch; no synthetic policy snapshot bypass.

routeJudgment.fixture: SP01 verify is not policy/consumer equivalent to the specified sp05-loan-execute-once live profile; unsupported live labels are a source gap, not merely absent real registration.
routeJudgment.earlyRefusal: Null invocation identities can be retained as diagnostics but cannot justify closing unknown ownership.
routeJudgment.votes: The latest user routing permits Fable implementation and GPT-6 checking; accepting a properly authorized current-route identity is not itself a blocker. Distinct vendor labels alone do not establish fresh substantive non-author resource approval, and historic votes must remain unchanged. No new grant is approved here.
routeJudgment.producer: The full accounting producer, charged observer and concrete instance remain pending. Their absence alone is not this verdict's basis; accepted invalid current evidence and missing required caller/verifier interfaces are tested source defects.
routeJudgment.wrapper: Existing static C wrapper is present and unchanged. The finding is missing full argv validation at its caller, not missing wrapper source.

positiveEvidence: Ordinary complete isolated CLI path runs once, retains exact invocation/result digests and preserves financialAcceptance=pending/retryAllowed=false.
Existing focused tests cover genuine socket exchange, hostile nonce/ancestry/boot/store-event defects, replay, parent loss, raw failure retention and legacy runner behavior.
Actual final collector terminal/stop, containment and result write/fsync errors and stalls fail closed; each independent target fault was reached and stalled workers were absent afterward.
All37 frozen/live hashes and21 runtime Python hashes match; all four hook pins agree; no global activation.
incompleteChecks: Exhaustive review of every unchanged peripheral module and every external launcher source line was not completed before the automatic interruption; exact hashes were checked and existing launcher transport evidence/focused tests were retained.
No new direct long-stall test was executed for accounting._replace_file; lack of supervision is a source observation, not a claimed reproduced hang.
No live systemd deadline/activation behavior, Docker namespace, actual configured prover, wallet observer, financial submission or ledger result was tested.
The late-clock full-path case returned UNKNOWN/3 at+1746; it does not establish late success. Its deadline overrun and the separate cumulative-budget case are the recorded evidence.
The full original P01-P12 adversarial matrix and additional planned malformed-startup/locking controls were not completed. Listed regressions are requirements for repair, not performed future tests.
No source edit, global hook activation, real-instance adoption, resource increase or release approval was performed.
recommendation: Return all13 findings together to the author. Repair in existing modules on isolated fixtures, preserve prior evidence and producer dependencies, run focused/regression gates, repin/stage runtime for changed Python bytes, then obtain a fresh exact-source audit. This report grants no approval.
